benchmarkConditions: Sequential backend runs;20warmup+120samples per each six size/scale cases. Other agents coordinated to avoid GPU overlap,but machine/background load was not independently controlled. GL measured before native-only counters were added;GL timing code unchanged. Diagnostic host-call elapsed timings,not GPU timestamps or release performance acceptance.

OpenGL.notes: Frozen scene; 20 warmup + 120 samples. Completed time includes synchronous GPU completion and any surface-acquire pacing; present is measured separately. VSync is requested off on both backends, but modern actual PresentMode may fall back to Fifo. Upload submission time includes flushing preceding draws, not GPU transfer duration. Storage estimates cover tracked textures and pooled buffers, not driver VRAM. GPU timestamps unavailable: the pinned native C ABI does not expose timestamp-period conversion. Short runs are smoke checks; longer hardware runs required for release acceptance.

Metal.notes: Frozen scene; 20 warmup + 120 samples. Completed time includes synchronous GPU completion and any surface-acquire pacing; present is measured separately. VSync is requested off on both backends, but modern actual PresentMode may fall back to Fifo. Upload submission time includes flushing preceding draws, not GPU transfer duration. Storage estimates cover tracked textures and pooled buffers, not driver VRAM. GPU timestamps unavailable: the pinned native C ABI does not expose timestamp-period conversion. Short runs are smoke checks; longer hardware runs required for release acceptance.

interpretation: All measured modern cases selected Immediate with VSync requested false; direct acquisition and presentation each ~0.01–0.02ms,so direct surface acquisition does not explain the gap.

Metal submits23native command buffers and performs580buffer writes plus456bind-group creations per frozen frame. Buffer writes cost~2.5ms and QueueSubmit~2.3–2.8ms of host elapsed time. Vulkan shifts more host time into QueueSubmit (~6ms).

Driver calls and Finish can wait on GPU work or scheduling. These measurements cannot isolate GPU execution or prove absence of hidden scheduling waits. No speculative batching change or performance acceptance claim was made.
